source.text:
Three Berlin restaurants I discovered this year that I MUST visit again 🌍🤤

These are 3 completely different cuisines, and three spots that immediately made it onto my return list. If you’re looking for something beyond the usual Berlin restaurant recommendations, save these 👀

📍 Sweet Jamaica / Hasenheide 117, 10967 Berlin (Neukölln)
📍 Burma Bliss / Grolmanstraße 15, 10623 Berlin (Charlottenburg)
📍 Kin Za / Linienstraße 93, 10115 Berlin (Mitte)

Berlin restaurants | Berlin food guide | Jamaican food Berlin | Burmese food Berlin | Georgian food Berlin | where to eat in Berlin | restaurants Berlin
source.subtitles:
Three Berlin restaurants at Fried Up this year that deserve more hype.
First up, there's this Jamaican place in neukolln,
which makes one of the best jerk chicken
and fried plantains you'll eat in Berlin.
As usual, you can find every place's location in the description.
Next up, a restaurant that makes Burmese cuisine,
and honestly,
it was the first time in my life I tried food from me and Mar.
It was super interesting
and reminded me a bit of a fusion between Indian and Vietnamese.
Especially the tea leaf rice was super interesting.
By the way,
make sure to follow me to discover all of Berlin's best food spots.
Lastly, I have a place that's very special to me.
It makes delicious Georgian food,
but not just that,
the colorful decor makes it look more like a party place
than a classic restaurant.
Just try it out and you'll be in for a treat, because these are

'Georgian food' is a cuisine, not a dish, so it is left out of foods; 'me and Mar' is the transcript's misspelling of Myanmar, kept verbatim in the quote.

match.note: The post gives Hasenheide 117, which matches the Sweet Jamaica Food branch even though the post calls the area Neukölln.
The name differs (Burma Bliss vs Burma Restaurant), but the exact address Grolmanstraße 15 and the Burmese cuisine match the only Burmese candidate.
